claims.summary: C1 drawing and received date December 2, 2022; approval stamp October 12, 2023.
R2-65 section 2.164.1(b) imports Schedule M with accessory-unit/garden-suite and duplex/single-family substitutions; this is not a simple R1-B garden-suite application.

Indexed minutes record adoption of 23-077 and authorization of DP with Variances 000603 tied to December 2 plans, conditional on car-share security, revised arborist material and zoning compliance except duplex parking 2 to 1 and accessory-building area 37 to 42 m2; two-year lapse wording retained. Not proof conditions were discharged or permit issued.
Decision uses 000603; trackers also identify DPV00268 and later DDP01047 refers to it. Same case group; executed permit crosswalk remains missing.
Later tracker records Development Permit Issued July 9, 2025; plan approval stamp is July 7, 2025. These are different recorded events, not conflicting issuance dates.

Later brief attributes custom redesign to discontinued prefab kit and asserts unchanged footprint, dimensions, siting and setbacks. This is a source assertion, not verified construction or identification of a manufacturer.

evidence.locator: A0.0 DDP paragraph; A0.1 DDP paragraph

claims.summary: Unchanged-setbacks narrative is not reconciled: original C1 rear 4.20 m and sides 1.20/1.20 m differ from A0.1 rear 3.40 m and sides 1.10/1.30 m. Lot area differs 985.6 versus 980 m2; A0.1 FSR row uses 1947 as denominator despite 980 lot-area row. Do not merge revisions or silently repair values.

evidence.locator: A0.1 project info, DDP paragraph and zoning analysis

claims.summary: C1 asks for combined-side-yard variance, but indexed adopted motion lists parking and accessory-building area variances. The drawing request is not evidence that Council granted that setback variance.

Schedule M 2(d) names the buildings but supplies no endpoint algorithm. No standalone separation-space definition found in searched Schedule A. Setback definition is lot-boundary to building face; transferring it to building-to-building distance is unsupported.

Schedule A floor Area uses interior exterior-wall faces plus cantilevered elements and listed exclusions; Total Floor Area adds aggregation/exclusion semantics. Mapping C1 combined floor area/living area to Schedule M floor area remains unreviewed, including covered patio treatment.

evidence.locator: C1 area table and covered patio annotation
